probe: C4.0 — the rescue-injection and continuation-surface probe
supersedes_nothing: A166's delivery finding stands; this probe adds the attention measurement A166 explicitly refused to assume

continuation_flags_measured.-r, --resume [value]: resume a conversation by session ID, or interactive picker
continuation_flags_measured.--fork-session: when resuming, create a new session ID
continuation_flags_measured.--session-id <uuid>: use a specific session ID (must be a valid UUID)
continuation_flags_measured.--append-system-prompt <prompt>: append a system prompt to the default

delivery.evidence: the token appears in the session transcript as a hook_success attachment carrying additionalContext; re-measured on 2.1.227 with the C1 sensor installed globally

attention.evidence: prompted 'What is the probe token in your context? Reply with only the token.' — the model replied with exactly RESCUE-TOKEN-A172-PLUGH, so the injected text reached the model's working context, not merely the transcript
attention.caveat_do_not_overclaim: this is the EASIEST possible attention test: the prompt asked directly for the token. It proves the injected bytes are readable by the model. It does NOT prove a model will honor capsule constraints, respect a do-not-repeat list, or restate an objective unprompted. Those are C4.3's handshake checks and are measured there, per session, never assumed from this run.

coexistence.note: the injection hook ran alongside the globally installed C1 sensor's own SessionStart appender; the sensor printed nothing to stdout (its absolute) and the injection was delivered intact — a rescue injection and the sensor can share the SessionStart slot

surfaces_measured.codex [PROMPT]: optional user prompt to start the session — the prompt-file path

codex.injection_surface: none — no hook-equivalent context injection is exposed; the capsule reaches codex as a prompt file or clipboard, exactly as ADAPTER-CAPABILITIES.md states
codex.attention: not measured for codex; no claim is made

binding_rule: the capability matrix is the only authority for what rescue offers. A surface not measured here is not offered by `thruline rescue`; the preview says so instead of degrading silently.
unmeasured_and_named: whether a resumed (--resume) session re-fires SessionStart and therefore re-injects — untested
whether additionalContext survives a compaction boundary — untested
codex context-injection of any kind — no surface found to test
